message.content: {"action":"decrease_precision","reason":"Current best feasible point is symmetric_preadd coef_frac=14 at 8552.17 um^2 with SQNR>=60dB. Decreasing precision by one legal level is the only remaining precision move with an unvisited neighbor and is likely to reduce area further while the symmetric_preadd structure has already shown it can retain the 60dB threshold at lower precision than direct. This balances area reduction against numerical quality better than switching rounding, which has many unvisited options but no direct evidence of area benefit."}
